scenes.text: You probably think concrete is just dead, boring stone, but what if the next massive skyscraper you walk past is actually alive and breathing?
For centuries, crumbling infrastructure has been a multi-billion dollar disaster, but brilliant scientists just solved this by mixing ancient, dormant bacteria directly into the wet cement mix.
When a crack inevitably forms and rainwater seeps inside, it wakes these tiny organisms up to eat specific nutrients and literally excrete solid limestone, perfectly sealing the cracks from within.

This means entire cities of the future could repair themselves without a single human construction worker ever lifting a finger. Would you live inside a building that is technically alive? Let me know your thoughts in the comments and follow us for more mind-blowing science!
